topic: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit: Runtime Security for AI Agents

competitors.title: Microsoft Agent 365 Overview
key_points: Agent 365 is the control plane for AI agents — observe, govern, and secure

Three pillars: Observe (real-time visibility, agent registry, agent map), Govern (lifecycle management, access control, compliance), Secure (Entra identity, Purview data protection, Defender threat detection)
Centralized agent registry in Microsoft 365 admin center provides unified view of agent adoption, activity, and health
Role-specific oversight for security and business leaders with tailored insights
GA as of May 1, 2026 for Commercial segment on per-user basis
Requires Microsoft E5 as prerequisite; $15/user/month standalone or in Microsoft 365 E7
Pre-integrated ecosystem partner agents available at launch

competitors.title: Secure AI Agents at Scale Using Microsoft Agent 365
key_points: Extends existing security infrastructure (Defender, Entra, Purview) to agents with purpose-built capabilities
Five new security challenges: agent sprawl, over-privileged agents, tool misuse, misconfigured agents, prompt injection/data leakage
Entra provides visibility into agent identities, Conditional Access for agents, SASE for network traffic, agent governance and lifecycles
Purview provides data security posture management, sensitivity labels, DLP, insider risk management, auditing, eDiscovery, Compliance Manager
Defender provides agent security posture management, threat detection and blocking, threat investigation and hunting
Security teams work in existing tools with agent insights surfaced directly

competitors.title: Governance and Security for AI Agents Across the Organization (Cloud Adoption Framework)
key_points: Every agent must be observable, governed, and secure — agents access data, take actions, operate with delegated authority

Six governance practices: assign organizational accountability, maintain agent registry, require single identity per agent, enforce policies consistently, observe agent activity, track and allocate costs
Data governance: enforce data privacy, mandate data residency, define data retention policies
Responsible AI: isolate confidential data, restrict data access, standardize knowledge integrations, mandate transparency, enforce fairness

Security: mandate agent security training, require AI threat protection, enforce infrastructure security, mandate adversarial testing, filter inputs/outputs, standardize authentication, enforce least privilege, integrate with SOC, govern external integrations, establish incident response plans
Standardize on MCP and A2A protocols for agent interactions
When Agent 365 not adopted, use separate services: Entra for identity, Purview for data governance, Defender for security monitoring, Azure Monitor for centralized monitoring

competitors.title: Microsoft Agent 365, Now Generally Available, Expands Capabilities and Integrations
key_points: GA announcement May 1, 2026 — Agent 365 is the control plane to observe, govern, and secure agents
New preview capabilities: agents operating independently with own credentials, discovery of shadow AI via Defender and Intune, Windows 365 for Agents, ecosystem SaaS agent coverage
Registry sync with AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud in public preview for cross-platform observability
Ecosystem partner agents fully managed by Agent 365: Genspark, Zensai, Egnyte, Zendesk, Kasisto, Kore.ai, n8n
Shadow AI detection: discover OpenClaw, GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Code on Windows devices via Defender + Intune
Context mapping for each agent: devices, MCP servers, identities, cloud resources
Runtime blocking of malicious coding agents via Defender with incident context
Entra network controls extended to Copilot Studio agents and local agents for network-layer inspection

competitors.title: Microsoft Agent 365: The Control Plane for AI Agents
key_points: IDC predicts 1.3 billion agents by 2028

Five capabilities: Registry (single source of truth via Entra), Access Control (unique agent ID, policy templates, least privilege), Visualization (unified dashboard, agent map, ROI tracking), Interoperability (Work IQ, Microsoft 365 apps, Copilot Studio, Foundry, Agent Framework, Agent 365 SDK), Security (Defender threat detection, Purview data protection)

Ecosystem partners: Adobe, Databricks, Cognition, Genspark, Glean, Kasisto, Manus, NVIDIA, n8n, SAP, ServiceNow, Workday

angles: Agent 365 is Microsoft's answer to agent sprawl — the first unified control plane that treats agents as managed organizational resources with identity, policy, and lifecycle controls
The three-pillar framework (Observe, Govern, Secure) provides a practical mental model for any organization building an agent governance strategy, even without Microsoft tooling
Shadow AI detection is the killer feature — discovering unmanaged agents (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Copilot CLI) running on employee devices closes a critical blind spot for security teams
Cross-platform governance via registry sync with AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud makes Agent 365 a multi-cloud control plane, not just a Microsoft-only tool
The Agent 365 SDK and ecosystem partner program create a governance moat — agents built with or integrated into Agent 365 are inherently more trustworthy than unmanaged alternatives

Runtime security is the differentiator: real-time blocking of malicious agent behavior via Defender, combined with Entra Conditional Access and Purview DLP, provides defense-in-depth for agentic workflows
Windows 365 for Agents introduces a new compute class — Cloud PCs purpose-built for agent workloads, managed in Intune with the same security controls as employee devices
The Agentic Center of Enablement for Power Platform shows Microsoft's vision: AI agents governing other AI agents, creating a self-managing governance loop
